task.ques: Look up the definition and pronunciation of the word "impeccable" and also find an example sentence using that word.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Impeccable (adjective) means “perfect, with no problems or bad parts.” UK and US pronunciation: /ɪmˈpek.ə.bəl/ (im-PEK-uh-buhl). Example: “His English is impeccable.”
Source: Cambridge Dictionary, https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/impeccable (accessed 27 October 2026).
